pins.what_it_is: A full-size timber Noah’s Ark attraction in Williamstown, Kentucky, built to the Genesis 6 dimensions as Answers in Genesis understands them. Guests walk three decks of exhibits about the Flood account, animal care aboard the Ark, and related teaching. It is a themed ministry attraction for families, not a floating ship or an excavation site.
pins.operator: Answers in Genesis (Ark Encounter operated through AiG subsidiary Crosswater Canyon, per AiG press materials)

ark_specs.attribution: per Ark Encounter / Answers in Genesis
ark_specs.cubit_used: royal / long cubit (as stated by Ark Encounter)
structure_claims_paraphrased: Presented as a full-size model of Noah’s Ark on a foundation (not a sealed floating vessel; multiple guest entrances for safety and code).
Described by the ministry as the largest freestanding timber-frame structure in the world.
Press fact sheet cites about 3.3 million board feet of timber in the Ark structure (exhibits inside not counted).

top_exhibits: Three interior decks with teaching exhibits on Ark construction, animal kinds, and spacing
Pre-Flood world displays and the Door of the Ark photo stop
Flood geology / post-Flood teaching exhibits (ministry presentation)
“Why the Bible Is True” / Doors of the Bible gospel walkthrough
Ararat Ridge Zoo and children’s animal areas

pins.what_it_is: A large Answers in Genesis museum and outdoor campus in Petersburg, Kentucky, west of the Cincinnati airport. Guests walk a biblical-history sequence from Eden through the Flood and Babel to Christ, plus gardens, a zoo, planetarium, and other family attractions. It is a ministry teaching museum, not a dig site.

Creation Zoo (including Wallaby Walkabout and related animal areas)

pins.what_it_is: HalleluYah Scriptures is a Bible translation and publishing project that restores the divine Name and prints it with Paleo-Hebrew letter forms (and related Name forms for the Son), alongside an English text that aims for a more literal rendering and Hebraic name spellings. It is sold and often given freely through their website; DigIntoScripture does not reproduce their copyrighted wording.

Torah of YHWH and other companion booklets listed on the site
